thread:
alice: 🚨 Observability alert — canary for /prompt-route-2 (route-experimental-v2) in prod is spiking: 5xx↑, p95 ~800ms, error-rate ~6% over 5m. Hotfix rollout looks suspect. Paging @matt (oncall).

sre-bot: Created INC-2026-342: "canary-route-v2-5xx-spike". Pager sent to matt.

matt (oncall): I have access, looking at logs and deploy traces now. What's the rollback plan?

ben: logs show runtime warnings about kernel / cudnn mismatch on canary nodes. model runtime failing to allocate KV cache — errors start at 13:12:02 UTC.

alice: plan: snap-stop the rollout and flip feature flag to divert traffic to stable route. Carla, can you confirm CS/CX impact?

carla: CS: 2 customers reported truncated replies in last 10m; we've triaged severity as medium and opened ticket to CX queue. Notifying affected accounts.

alice: executing FF toggle now.

alice: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.internal/api/flags/route-experimental-v2/toggle" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"state":"off","scope":"prod","note":"emergency snap-stop 5201119876"}'
```

deploy-bot: Feature flag toggle accepted. route-experimental-v2 -> OFF for prod. Propagation started.

sre-bot: Routing change detected: 100% of canary traffic diverted to route-stable-1. Telemetry will refresh within 30s.

matt (oncall): Confirmed — 5xx rate dropping, p95 back to ~120ms after 45s. Marking mitigated for now. Will coordinate patch rollback and canary gating fix.

ben: opening PR to pin runtime/kernel matrix + add healthcheck that verifies KV cache allocation on startup.

carla: CS notified customers and posted interim message. Will escalate if we see regression.

alice: INC-2026-342 -> mitigated. Assign follow-up: root cause + release process change. Thanks team :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Follow-up ops: add canary gating and automated FF emergency playbook link: https://internal.redwood/incident-playbooks/ff-emergency
